name: MCP-Bench
intro: MCP-Bench是一个基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的评测基准，旨在评估大型语言模型在真实多步任务中的工具使用能力。它连接了28个MCP服务器和250个工具，涵盖金融、旅行、科学计算等领域，测试模型在工具检索、多步规划和跨域协作方面的表现。
build_method: LLM 自动合成, 人工检查
metric: 规则执行指标, LLM 评判分数, 总分
eval_feature: 动态, 实时, 多轮, 领域特定
scale: 104 个任务, 28 个服务器, 250 个工具
intro_en: MCP-Bench is an evaluation benchmark based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), designed to assess large language models' ability to use tools in real multi-step tasks. It connects 28 MCP servers and 250 tools across domains such as finance, travel, and scientific computing, testing models on tool retrieval, multi-step planning, and cross-domain collaboration.

flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect 28 live servers with 250 tools across 11 domains"] --> B["Discover tool I/O dependency chains and synthesize 104 tasks with o4-mini"]
    B --> C["Filter for solvability at least 9/10 and utility at least 5/10, then inspect manually"]
    C --> D["Fuzz instructions while preserving required numbers and add 10 distractor servers per task"]
    D --> E["Run agents for up to 20 rounds of planning, execution, observation compression, and state update"]
    E --> F["Check tool-name validity, schema compliance, runtime success, and dependency order"]
    F --> G["Use o4-mini rubrics for completion, tool use, and planning on a 1-10 scale"]
    G --> H["Shuffle rubrics five times, normalize, average, and report all metrics"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.20453, Sections 4.1, 4.2, 5.1, and 5.2. The paper collects 28 live MCP servers with 250 tools across 11 domains; discovers inherent and scenario-based dependency chains; uses o4-mini to synthesize 56 single-server, 30 two-server, and 18 three-server tasks; filters at solvability 9/10 and utility 5/10 before human inspection; fuzzes instructions while retaining required numbers; attaches 10 distractor servers and 100-plus extra tools per task; executes up to 20 rounds; combines rule checks with o4-mini rubric scores; and shuffles each rubric five times before normalization and averaging.
